dimension_pack.description: Pacote customizado de 10 dimensoes para avaliar plataformas opensource cujo alvo e 'agentes de IA servindo multiplas equipes/projetos numa empresa sem perder contexto'. Pesos somam 1.00.

dimensions.label: Multi-tenancy
dimensions.description: Isolamento real entre teams/workspaces, com permissions e privacy walls entre agentes e dados.

dimensions.label: Governance & Audit
dimensions.description: Audit trail imutavel, policy enforcement em runtime, approval gates e aderencia ao OWASP Agentic Top 10.

dimensions.label: Paradigm flexibility
dimensions.description: Suporte a multiplos paradigmas (pipeline, role-play, company-sim, digital-employee) ou lock-in em um so.

dimensions.label: Memory architecture
dimensions.description: Memory tipado em graph + vector + verbatim; atribuicao por entity/process; isolamento multi-tenant.

dimensions.label: Skill marketplace
dimensions.description: Packaging, share, approval workflow e distribuicao org-wide de skills/tools.

dimensions.label: Durability
dimensions.description: Event-sourced replay, crash recovery, persistencia de sessoes longas e checkpoint.

dimensions.label: Safety & sandboxing
dimensions.description: Sandboxed execution, safe-outputs handler, permission gates e privilege rings.

dimensions.label: Observability
dimensions.description: Traces, custo por team, eval metrics, dashboards e SLOs integrados.

dimensions.label: Deployment flex
dimensions.description: Self-host, cloud, hybrid; containerizacao; zero cloud lock-in.

dimensions.label: Community
dimensions.description: Tracao observavel (releases, i18n, discord, docs, adopters) — apenas o que o README/package.json atesta.
